cause_quote: The original usage dashboard built suggestion catalogs as `unique(sessions.map((s) => s.agentId)).slice(0, 6)` (and the same for channels, providers, models, tools) before filtering them by the typed value.
user_saw: Typing a Usage filter such as model:seventh offered no autocomplete suggestion when the matching model, provider, agent, channel or tool was beyond the first six catalog entries.
summary: Filters the full categorical catalog by the typed value first and only then caps the suggestions at six.
reasoning: GraphQL blame put the slice-then-filter code on the deslop refactor 8bfe139a13b0 and the module split 68dbbc7c5ff1, but both only moved the existing `values.slice(0, 6)` before the match; the raw file at 8a352c8f9dfd (Web UI: add token usage dashboard, #10072) already capped each catalog to six before `includes(value)` filtering. The defect therefore shipped with the feature.
